create_category_index: create a dictionary of COCO compatible categories keyed by category id from a list of category dicts
convert_label_map_to_categories: convert a label map proto to a list of category dicts for evaluation with a max class count
get_max_label_map_index: get the maximum label id from a StringIntLabelMap proto
create_class_agnostic_category_index: create a single object class category index for class-agnostic object detection tasks
validate_label_map: validate a StringIntLabelMap proto to ensure all label ids are greater than or equal to 1
